_comment: Hand-written get5 0.6.0 match config for testing without the bot.
Put this at csgo/cfg/get5/testmatch.json on the game server, then run:
The path is relative to the csgo directory, NOT to cfg/.
Replace the STEAM_ ids below with real ones. Find yours in-game with the
players_per_team and min_players_to_ready are set to 1 so a single player
per side can ready up. Raise both to 5 for a real 5v5.
